# sendio_inbox (Resource)

An agent inbox: an email address an AI agent sends and receives with through the API. It lives on one of your verified domains or, when `domain` is left out, on the shared agent domain (no DNS work). Destroying it stops the address receiving; its threads stay readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# On the shared agent domain: no DNS work needed.
resource "sendio_inbox" "support_agent" {
  username     = "acme-support"
  display_name = "Acme Support"
}

# On your own verified domain.
resource "sendio_inbox" "sales_agent" {
  username     = "sales"
  domain       = "mail.example.com"
  display_name = "Acme Sales"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) Your own idempotency id: creating an inbox with a client_id that already exists returns that inbox. Changing it creates a new inbox.
- `display_name` (String) Sender name shown with the address (at most 100 characters, no quotes or angle brackets).
- `domain` (String) A verified sending domain of yours, or a company subdomain of the shared agent domain. Defaults to the shared agent domain. Changing it creates a new inbox.
- `username` (String) Local part of the address (a-z, 0-9, dot, dash, underscore, plus). Generated when left out. Changing it creates a new inbox.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The inbox address.
- `created_at` (String) When the inbox was created.
- `id` (String) Inbox id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By id or by address
terraform import sendio_inbox.support_agent acme-support@agents.send.io
```
